sn34.5:1.4: imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca
sn34.5:1.5: uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi
sn34.5:1.6: dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā …pe… pavaro cāti. sāvatthī. cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī.
sn34.5:1.7: katame cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na
sn34.5:1.8: samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na
